shortDescription: VRAX is drawing community attention on Robinhood, with a current market capitalization of $3.82 million. According to Odaily, one source said Vlad has just released Commander Vrax, and another source said Commander Vrax is now a cat. Another post on X said Cashcat has a new cat friend named VRAX.
